name: Cosmetic Drops
description: Needs the Exciting build of LocalExile (github.com/marshmellion/LocalExile, branch exciting). Works with Body Auras (body auras drop too and are locked until found). Cosmetics and bought hideouts are no longer all owned: they drop. Target-farm each one where it fits (Sirus's from Sirus, a tileset's in its maps) as a Sealed Cosmetic, or open Cosmetic Caches for random ones, or both.
author: marshmellion
